verdict.rationale: The only on-topic evidence is thin. A community comment lists protected branches as a Team-plan feature, which is a branch-level governance control. The docs describe fine-grained personal access tokens that are granted a set of permissions defining which resources they can access, though that scopes tokens rather than assigning roles to people. missing for 10: documented organization-level role assignment, project-level permissions, repository-level user/team permission assignment, environment-level protection or permissions, and first-party docs on branch protection.
